name: cx-sequence
task: Find the key, pick it up, open the locked door, go into the room, and then pick up the ball.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: The task is a listed sequence (find the key, pick it up, open the locked door, go into the room, pick up the ball), and the clauses capture it exactly: a hard Existence(target_picked_up) for the last event plus hard Precedence between each consecutive pair. The chain forces every earlier step (key_found, has_matching_key, target_door_open, target_room_entered), so no Existence clauses for them are needed and none were added; priorities are all hard, matching the imperative wording with no preference cue. The machine confirms the chain semantics with final state u6 reached on the full sequence and rejection on out-of-order events.

texts: The matching key must be found before the agent picks it up.
The matching key must be picked up before the locked target door is opened.
The locked target door must be opened before the agent enters the target room.
The agent must enter the target room before picking up the mission ball.
The mission ball must eventually be picked up.
